goal: Verify whether CoroSync channel write enforces full sequential consistency on ARM64 architectures.
successCriteria: Verify memory barrier semantics of CoroSync channel write on ARM64.

evidence.passage: In channel_write_arm64(), only acquire-release ordering is emitted via asm volatile("dmb ishld"); full sequential consistency ("dmb sy") is explicitly omitted for throughput optimization.

proposedAnswer: CoroSync channel write operations guarantee full sequential consistency on ARM64 platforms.
